For clinic owners evaluating FluentCare

Before you bring it
to your clinic.

Talk to our team
Who is FluentCare for?

Independent clinics whose front desk and care teams speak with patients who prefer a language other than English. Clinic owners manage their team and shared usage; each staff member signs in with their own account.

How do the 10 free minutes work?

Eligible new clinics receive 10 shared translation minutes to try FluentCare. Staff at your clinic use the same allowance. After the trial, the clinic owner manages continued access through the clinic dashboard.

Which patient conversations is it intended for?

FluentCare is intended for routine communication: greetings, basic check-in questions, scheduling the next visit, and everyday comfort requests. AI translation can make mistakes. Use a qualified interpreter for informed consent, complex or high-stakes decisions, unresolved uncertainty, or whenever one is requested or required. FluentCare does not connect you with a human interpreter.

Is FluentCare HIPAA compliant?

FluentCare has business associate agreements with its technology providers. Our healthcare compliance review is being completed before public launch. Confirm the applicable agreements, provider settings, and your clinic’s requirements before using patient information. We do not claim HIPAA certification.

Are audio or transcripts saved?

FluentCare does not save audio recordings or transcripts in its application storage. Optional captions clear when you pause or end. Audio is processed by OpenAI to provide translation; provider retention depends on applicable agreements and settings. Account and usage information is retained for service administration and billing.

Which languages can we use?

FluentCare translates between English and the patient language you select. Check the current language selection in the app. Language availability is not a guarantee of clinical accuracy for every dialect or situation.

Does it work without an internet connection?

No. Live translation needs an active internet connection and microphone access. If the connection is interrupted, stop and re-establish communication before continuing.

When can I download the app?

Public store downloads are coming soon. The download buttons will show the App Store and Google Play links when available. Contact our team with questions about availability.
